entities.title: Command-line helpers
entities.summary: The logic behind the init, uninit, hook and report commands: wiring zazzle and the indexer's redirect hook into a project's Claude Code settings and taking them out again, deciding which raw reads and searches to redirect to zazzle, and summarising the usage log.
entities.purpose: Holds the static classes src/Program.cs calls: Init merges zazzle's server when the daemon is installed, the hook and zazzle's permission into .mcp.json and .claude/settings.json; Uninit removes exactly those entries again, cutting them out of the file text with JsonText so every other byte stays; HookPolicy classifies a Claude Code tool call; Report aggregates usage.jsonl into what to improve next.
boundaries: Reading standard input, writing the usage-log record for the hook and choosing the exit code are in src/Program.cs.
The usage log's format belongs to src/UsageLog.cs (src/.dev/observability.json); Report only reads it.
The daemon commands (status, stop, restart) are client code of the daemon protocol and live in src/Daemon/Control.cs.
